        return grid
    
    bg = grid[0][0]
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    
    result = [[bg] * cols for _ in range(rows)]
    
    # Find all non-bg cells by color
    by_color = {}
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color not in by_color:
                    by_color[color] = []
                by_color[color].append((r, c))
    
    for color, positions in by_color.items():

        min_r = min(p[0] for p in positions)
        max_r = max(p[0] for p in positions)

        width = max_c - min_c + 1
